title: OpenClaw vs Perplexity: AI Agent vs AI Search Engine — What's the Difference?
summary: OpenClaw vs Perplexity: one takes actions and automates workflows, the other answers questions instantly. Both are AI tools, but built for fundamentally different jobs.
body_markdown: They solve different problems, so "better" isn't the right frame. Perplexity is better for instant research — ask a question, get a cited answer in seconds. OpenClaw is better for autonomous action — it runs continuously, connects to your real tools, and takes action without you being present. If you need a quick fact, use Perplexity. If you need something done while you sleep, use OpenClaw.
